messages:
maria: Heads-up: API v2 -> v3 compatibility roadmap sync. Need to confirm ownership for deprecation windows & SDK release dates. Ping owners: @raj @emily @aj

raj: Quick question — can we enumerate the hard blockers that prevent starting the deprecation window? Off the top: websocket streaming behavior differences, legacy auth header parsing, and a couple of SDK breaking changes.

emily: I can own SDK 3.0 changelog + migration guide. Targeting a 2-week cadence for RCs, planning first RC on 2026-07-07. Will need the runtime flags to be stable before cutting.

aj: Working on runtime flags now. Draft PR: `github.com/redwood/infra/pull/421` (WIP). Needs review + perf runs. ETA end of this week if CI stays green.

maria: Thanks. @samir can you validate routing/fallback behavior for the old endpoints? We want an automatic fallback to compatible model variants when `x-api-version` is missing or set to v2.

samir: Will do. Quick local repro I used:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-api-version: v2" https://api.redwood.dev/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
Local proxy fallback works, but I hit a 1% edge case where KV cache mismatch causes a 502 on longer contexts. Logging a repro.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `runtime-flags/v3` on prod-cluster-2 — 12/12 nodes updated so far.

raj: If runtime flags land, SDK needs a feature flag toggle for streaming behavior (to flip between old and new streaming wire format). @emily can you add that to the SDK API?

emily: Confirmed. Will add `StreamingCompat` flag to SDK public config and include a migration example in the guide. Also will add a console deprecation banner so customers see the upcoming change.

maria: Milestone plan for visibility:
A) Runtime flags merged + canary (this week)
B) SDK 3.0 RC (2 weeks after A)
C) Customer communications + 30-day deprecation window after RC
Does that look accurate? Any objections?

aj: No objections. If perf tests pass I'll promote the PR to prod after canary.

samir: I'll open a regression issue for the KV cache mismatch: #1327 and add test cases.

raj: Also want a fallback metric: `v2_fallback_rate` and a dashboard so we can monitor unexpected falls back to compatibility layer. Tagging SRE.

lee: lee: Happy to take this. I'll add the `v2_fallback_rate` metric, dashboard, and an alert that fires if >0.5% over 1h.

maria: Great. Assigning owners here: Runtime flags -> aj; SDK changelog & migration guide -> emily; Routing/fallback validation -> samir; Metrics/dashboard -> lee; Customer comms + migration outreach -> raj + product.

maria: I'll update the project tracker (board: infra/api-compatibility) with the milestones and owners. Please add any blocking items as comments on the card.

emily: I'll post the SDK changelog draft in the docs channel when ready.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — we'll keep this thread for async check-ins. If anything urgent pops, ping in #eng-alerts.
